'''2008 Worlds Team Bryan Batdorf LS It Is The Future You See''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Bryan Batdorf]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Team Tournament). Sheet title Jeeps Is Wearing A Bowling Shirt? Naboo Gungan package.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Bryan Batdorf]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[It Is The Future You See / Careful For What You Wish For (V)|It Is The Future You See (V)]]
* '''Stage:''' Team Tournament
